name: Clocked In applies its instant-cast buff from Discordance (#2961)
contract: Clocked In 706076 applies aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on Clocked In 520168, but Spell.dbc gives it ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so it never procced. With a spell_proc row gated on the magic class damage of Discordance (100% chance), a single Discordance hit should apply the 520168 buff to the caster.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
No Clocked In buff before any cast
Discordance's hit applies the Clocked In buff
